title: Less Rubbish
text:
Many cities have a problem with waste. People throw away plastic bottles, bags, and paper every day. This waste can damage rivers and the air. Some cities want to help people recycle more.

A group of students started a recycling program at their school. They put bins in each classroom. Now the school produces less rubbish. Many families want to copy their idea.

questions.text: What can waste damage, according to paragraph one?
What did the students put in each classroom?
Why do some cities want people to recycle more?
What can we infer about the students' program?
options: It was successful and others may copy it
It only worked for one day

vocabulary.definition: materials that are thrown away because they are no longer needed
to use materials again so they do not become waste
containers used to put rubbish in
things that are thrown away because they are not wanted

paragraph_translations: Muchas ciudades tienen un problema con los residuos. Las personas tiran botellas de plástico, bolsas y papel todos los días. Estos residuos pueden dañar los ríos y el aire. Algunas ciudades quieren ayudar a la gente a reciclar más.
Un grupo de estudiantes empezó un programa de reciclaje en su escuela. Pusieron contenedores en cada aula. Ahora la escuela produce menos basura. Muchas familias quieren copiar su idea.
